{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id and keep the highest sample_seq
# This ensures we have the final measurement for each patient
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Verify the data now has one row per patient
print(f'Number of unique patients after deduplication: {trial_df["patient_id"].nunique()}')

# Check the distribution of arms
print('\nArm distribution:')
print(trial_df["arm"].value_counts())

# Check the distribution of severity by arm
print('\nSeverity by arm:')
print(trial_df.groupby('arm')['severity'].value_counts())"}
